note: Town of Hanna park on the neck of land between Fox Lake and Helmer Reservoir, about two miles west of town, with a campground manager on site in season. The Plover Bay row (sites 26-32) and the two tenting pads face Fox Lake across open grass; the full-service loop (Blue Bird Close) sits back from the reservoir beside the boat launch. Tenting sites and an unserviced overflow area as well; floating docks on both waters, non-motorized boats only on Helmer Dam. --Claude
summary: Town page read: one campground (44 sites) on the neck between the two waters, not two places. Season close corrected 09-15 -> 09-30, sewer added (18 full-service sites), count 44, washrooms/water/wifi added; first-come only confirmed (group area alone is reserved). Fees table unchanged from the stored read (effective April 1, 2025). No maximum length, stay limit or seasonal leases mentioned.
flags: ONE CAMPGROUND: the town's map shows Gander Ridge (1-18), Plover Bay (26-32), Owl's Nest (19-25, group) and Blue Bird Close (33-44) all within about 300 m on the neck between Fox Lake and Helmer Reservoir; 'Helmer Dam Recreation Area' is the day-use/boating side of the same park. No split.
SEASONAL LEASES: the town page mentions none ('Reservations are NOT accepted'); every non-group site is first-come nightly.

FEES (stored, not rewritten): the page still shows the table 'effective Apr 1, 2025': Tent $25, Non-Serviced $25, Power (20 or 30 amp) $30, Power and Water $35, Full-Service Site $40. Stored nightly_low is 30 (the power rate); the lowest RV rate is the $25 non-serviced one, but the FAQ's site list has no unserviced numbered sites (only 'space in the overflow area for RV's not requiring services'), so 30 was left. Tax treatment not stated.

SITE-LIST DISCREPANCY between two town documents: the FAQ says 19 sites with 15 amp, 7 with 30 amp, 18 full service (30 amp); the park map's legend says Gander Ridge 1-16 20 amp, 17-18 30 amp + water, Plover Bay 26-32 20 amp + water, Owl's Nest 19-25 20 amp, Blue Bird Close 33-44 30 amp + water + sewer (12 sites). The map is older (undated); the FAQ was used.

WATERFRONT (stored lakefront - confirmed for a few sites, with the caveat written into the note): on the town map and Esri imagery the Plover Bay spurs (about sites 29-32) and tent pads T1-T2 are 15-40 m from the Fox Lake shore with open mown grass between; Owl's Nest group sites 19-25 are about 35-45 m from Helmer Reservoir across a walking path and grass; Gander Ridge 1-18 is in a tree belt 35-120 m from Fox Lake; Blue Bird Close (the full-service loop) is 30-70 m from the reservoir with the pumphouse, boat-launch parking and shrubs between. Recommend keeping lakefront on the strength of the Plover Bay sites only.
